main_text.l: » cas,cæteraq; id genus mercimonia alibi quam » Groninge in stapulæ loco more folito venun-dare, venū ve proponere, vel in regiones alias » præterita Groninga exportare aut abigere: Excepta modo effent, quæ hujus generis viris nobilibus in prædiis ipsorum provenirent, quibus jus effet pro libitu & commodo suo ea divendere: idemq; valeret de DAMMONENSI-BUS. Exempta quoque stapulæ legi mane-ret præfectura vetus, utereturque jure ac liber-tate pristina, emeret, venderet, cerevisiam co-queret pro libitu, uti folebat, quoad duraret » hæc sequestris ratio: Groninganietiam in exi-» genda pecunia credita & reditibus aliis per » agrum retinerent jus & morem folitum, » modò ut judex in eo tribunali in urbe esset » ipse Thorenius, aut legatus eius, aliusve » pro eo sequester ab ordinibus imperii datus.

Atq; hæc probata signataq; ab utraq; parte, & sigillis quoq; duorum intercessorum ad fidem munita: deniq; pax constitutu. Nec multò post ALBERTUS jam tum corpore agro Emdam de-latus, atq; ibi vita functus est. THORENIUS vero intempestive Frisiâ evocatus ab HENRI-CO Alberti filio, malis adhuc haud bene posi-tis, quæ in rep. sociorum hærebant, (erant .n. nobilitatis agraria animi in civitatem, & huius vicissim in illam ex injuriis mutuis exacerbati) quibus ipsum se interponere, remedium, adhibere convenieb at, cum ditius etiam quam par esset, emansitaret, occasioni fuit, ut anno proximo in arma rursum sit itum, transactio, neglecta pene evanuerit. page.notes: Left-margin notes are partly faded; "Alberti Sax." and "onis mors." are read as one note. The note "Bellum inter Saxones & Groninga-mes ienatū." is set beside the lines and its last word is doubtful (ienatū read as ienatum). "convenieb at" appears to have a gap and is doubtful. "emansitaret" is read from a faded long s and is doubtful. "cÿs fu-" at the foot is faint and doubtful. Greek ę/ogonek marks and some abbreviation marks are uncertain. The "»" marks at line starts are printed and kept. The paragraph breaks are inferred from line endings and indentation, which are faint.
